snippet.title: CAUTION WET PAINT Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
CAUTION WET PAINT launches to Steam on July 15th, 2026! Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4827850/CAUTION_WET_PAINT/

This is a game about watching paint dry in real time.
It takes anywhere between 2 and 5 hours to dry completely.
Relax and listen to the ambient music and sounds while you wait.
Touch the paint when you think it looks dry.
If you're right, you win!
If you're wrong, you lose and have to start over.
